source: Club banguide/hole notes and reviews gathered by the research pass; see course facts in the commit history.

1.note: Par 4, 386 m, index 10. THE ONLY HOLE THAT CHANGED between the 2020 and 2023 cards — lengthened +31 m from Vit, +14 m from Gul. Bunkering is heavy by this course's standards: five bunkers. A pond sits 14 m right at 84% of the hole — peripheral, not on the line. OSM maps this green fully: 59.56753 N, 16.86843 E, pin node 13012079636. The green is 233 m from the Mälaren shoreline (the second-closest point on the course to water) and 144 m from the clubhouse. A newly built practice area lies immediately BEHIND the first tee, and the club's 18 on-site beds are advertised as 'med första tee och övn

2.note: Par 4, 348 m, index 6. THE CLOSEST HOLE ON THE COURSE TO MÄLAREN — its line of play comes within about 137 m of the shore and the green within 142-144 m. Even so it is not a shoreline hole: a belt of grazed pasture, scrub and a broad reedbed fringe lies between. Water in play is a ditch at the tee and a large 1309 m² pond around the green — corroborated independently by OSM, which maps a golf=lateral_water_hazard (way 1415933872, 1208 m²) just north of this green at 59.56743, 16.87435. OSM green centre 59.56715, 16.87432, pin node 13012115813.

3.note: Par 3, 179 m, index 8. Longest of the four short holes and one of the straightest on the course (within ~30 m of its tee-green line). The hole-2 tee pond sits behind this tee; a 153 m² pond lies 19 m right at 42%. One bunker. OSM pin node 13012115906 at 59.56837, 16.87134. About 210 m from the shoreline.

4.note: Par 4, 337 m, index 2 — the second-hardest hole on the card off a very ordinary length, so the difficulty is entirely in the green complex. TWO PONDS GUARD THE GREEN: 360 m² on the line at 83%, and 410 m² six metres left at 97%. The fairway bends LEFT about 45 m. OSM green 59.57190, 16.87266, pin node 13012116055. The right rough here faces the 5th tee across a mound the club dug out in October 2023.

5.note: Par 5, 493 m, index 18 — the easiest hole on the card by index despite being the second-longest, and the ONLY HOLE ON THE COURSE WITH NO BUNKERS AT ALL. Bends LEFT about 80 m. Ponds at 74% and 81% sit on the line. Internal out-of-bounds between 5 and 6 is defined by white/black stakes: 'Dessa pinnar behandlas som föremål för banans gräns under spel av hål 5. Vid spel från hål 6 är de oflyttbara tillverkade föremål' — i.e. the same stakes are a boundary from one hole and an immovable obstruction from the other. An on-course toilet stands here. In Oct 2023 the club dug away the small mound right

6.note: Par 4, 337 m, index 16. Bends RIGHT about 57 m. A 1003 m² pond crosses the hole at roughly 70% — one of the larger bodies on the course and genuinely on the line. Three bunkers. The right-hand boundary is the electric WILD BOAR FENCE that defines out-of-bounds on holes 6, 7, 16 and 17; beyond it is open arable farmland. About 233 m from the shoreline.

7.note: Par 5, 545 m, index 4 — the longest hole on the course from every tee, and the BIGGEST DOGLEG: the fairway bends RIGHT by about 103 m at 40% of its length. Essentially dry, with only one small pond 34 m right at 91%. Boar-fence OB down the right. The walk from this green to the 8th tee is about 189 m, the third-longest transfer on the course.

8.note: Par 4, 344 m, index 14. One of the straight holes (within ~30 m of its tee-green line). A pond sits 8 m right at about 53% — close enough to be a visual presence without being a carry.

9.note: Par 3, 143 m, index 12 — the shortest hole, and from Ora only 55 m, the shortest value on the entire card. A BROOK RUNS RIGHT BY THE GREEN, confirmed twice over: the banguide places a 154 m² water body straddling the line at about 84%, immediately short of the putting surface, and the club's own blog says 'några alar som växer vid bäcken intill green, även detta på hål 9' (Feb 2024, alders by the brook and oaks on the back tee being felled). One bunker. The green is 159 m from the clubhouse and the walk to the 10th tee is only 111 m; the club's kiosk sits at 9/10.

10.note: Par 5, 527 m, index 1 — the hardest hole on the card, and remarkably the one hole with NO WATER ANYWHERE IN ITS CORRIDOR. Shaped as a gentle S: left early, then right about 41 m late. One bunker. The 10th tee is 106 m from the clubhouse; in August 2024 the club ran a week-long trial of starting rounds from here (19-25 Aug).

11.note: Par 4, 340 m, index 17. SIX BUNKERS — the most on any hole, against a course average of two. Bends RIGHT about 45 m. A 249 m² pond sits at about 21%, squarely in the driving zone. This green to the 12th tee is the LONGEST TRANSFER ON THE COURSE at about 298 m, where the routing crosses between wooded upland blocks.

12.note: Par 3, 169 m, index 9. Water at 25% and again behind the green — a rare back-of-green hazard. One bunker. Sits on the high inland back nine at 12-15 m elevation, 1.4-1.7 km from Mälaren, so no water view at all here.

13.note: Par 4, 426 m, index 5 — THE LONGEST PAR 4 on the course by 68 m. Straight (within ~30 m of its line). Ditches lie 30-41 m left at 41% and 58% — well off the corridor. Its green is the HIGH POINT OF THE COURSE at 15.2 m.

14.note: Par 4, 350 m, index 11. Bends LEFT about 73 m, the third-strongest turn on the course. A small pond sits 4 m left of the green — very tight to the putting surface. One bunker.

15.note: Par 3, 172 m, index 7 — THE WATER HOLE OF THE COURSE AND THE ONLY HOLE WITH A DROP ZONE. The local rules give it its own clause: a YELLOW penalty area, 'Om en boll är i det gula pliktområdet på hål 15 ... droppa den ursprungliga bollen eller en annan boll i droppzonen.' The pond is the LARGEST SINGLE WATER BODY ON THE COURSE at 1828 m², lying directly between tee and green with its near edge on the line of play about 140 m out and the green immediately beyond — verified visually on Esri satellite imagery with the banguide polygons overlaid. 16.note: Par 4, 338 m, index 13. Bends RIGHT about 71 m. A small 119 m² water body at about 41%. Internal OB in white stakes runs left of both the tee area and the fairway, shared with hole 15 and applying to play on both holes — a sign of how tight these two corridors are. Boar-fence OB down the right against farmland.

17.note: Par 4, 358 m, index 3 — the third-hardest hole and BY FAR THE WETTEST: nine separate water polygons, more than any other hole. A CONTINUOUS RED PENALTY AREA RUNS THE WHOLE LEFT SIDE, and the local rules declare it infinite where it is bounded on one side only: 'Det röda pliktområdet på vänster sida om hål 17 som bara är definierat på en sida är oändligt.' The chain is a meandering ditch plus ponds at roughly 8%, 23%, 51%, 86%, 94% and just past the green, with two ponds left of the green itself. 18.note: Par 5, 497 m, index 15. Bends RIGHT about 55 m off the tee, then straightens for the run home. Water lies just THROUGH the green at 107-111% of the hole length — a hazard that punishes the long third rather than the layup. The green is 126 m from the clubhouse at 5.1 m elevation, closing the descent from the back nine's inland high ground.
